answer: The quill edge is published both ways, so a closed ring of 29 clones produces a signature the wharf analysis flags immediately. An copycat must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the tide settlement applies the void retroactively. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
